caption: The drawing depicts two wooden objects set against a plain, light beige background. The larger object is a cylindrical wooden mortar with two horizontal grooves etched around its curved body, rendered in various shades of brown that indicate the wood grain and texture. Inside the mortar, a wooden pestle is positioned at an angle, with a rounded handle and a thicker, rounded pounding end; the coloration of the pestle matches the mortar with light and dark brown tones showing the grain detail. To the left and slightly below the mortar and pestle, there is a smaller, separate wooden object resembling a smaller pestle or a mallet, also shown upright and featuring a handle and a wider base, with similar wood grain texture and brown coloring. The artist's name, "WELLINGTON BLEWETT," is written in small letters toward the lower right of the image.
title: Mortar and Pestle
